title: nbn service disruption - Wodonga, VIC
current_summary:
Affects some nbn services in Wodonga, VIC. Services were restored at 11:45 am AEDT on 15 November 2026.

Resolution: nbn reconfigured network to restore service

Services in your area have been restored following an unexpected network issue. If your service has not reconnected automatically, try restarting your Wi-Fi router and nbn Connection Box (if you have one).

cause.reason: nbn reconfigured its network to restore service

updates.content:
Affects some nbn services in the Wodonga, VIC area. The issue was reported at 4:09 am AEDT on 15 November 2026, and no restoration estimate has been provided yet.

nbn is working hard to resolve an unexpected network issue in your area causing a partial or total loss of connectivity to your nbn service. Using mobile data can help you stay connected if needed.
Services in the Wodonga, VIC area were restored at 11:45 am AEDT on 15 November 2026, and this outage is now resolved.
